raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`MiniCPM5Detector` (`minicpm5`) scans model output with patterns that go quadratic when a closing tag never arrives:

1. `detect_and_parse` uses `re.finditer(r"<function.*?</function>")`, which rescans to the end of the text from every `<function`.
2. The regex fallback, taken whenever a block isn't well-formed XML, runs `<param\s+name=...>([\s\S]*?)</param>` over the block. Every `<param name="...">` without a later `</param>` rescans to the end. Streaming re-parses each complete block with `detect_and_parse`, so this also hits a single streaming call.
3. `<param(?![^>]*\bname=)[^>]*>` rescans to the next `>` from every `<param`.

| Input | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| 100 KB of repeated `<function `, non-stream | 12.4 s | < 1 ms |
| 96 KB block with unclosed `<param name="...">` tags, non-stream | 12.7 s | fast |
| same, **one streaming call** | 13.7 s | fast |
| 112 KB of `<param` with no `>` | 0.4 s | fast |

Tool-call parsing runs synchronously on the tokenizer manager's event loop, so one such response stalls every in-flight request. Found with an Atheris fuzzing harness that records per-input parse time.

## Modifications

- `_iter_delimited`: a linear `str.find` scan returning the same spans as the `finditer`. The unused `func_call_regex` is removed.
- The `<param name=...>` `finditer` is bounded with `endpos` at the end of the last `</param>`. No match can end past it, so the matches are unchanged.
- `_has_param_missing_name`: a linear replacement for `_PARAM_MISSING_NAME_REGEX.search()`. For each `>`, it checks only the last `<param` before it. Every earlier `<param` sharing that `>` has a superset of its attribute text, so if any of them lacks `name=`, the last one does.
- Regression test in `test_minicpm5_detector.py` (fails on `main`, passes here).

## Accuracy Tests

- Differential test of `main` vs patched detector, comparing `detect_and_parse` and every streaming result under random re-chunking: **0 mismatches** over 20k random plus 20k mutated well-formed inputs.
- `_has_param_missing_name` vs the old regex on 200k random strings: identical.
- `test/registered/unit/function_call/`: all pass.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

See the table above.

Related: #42573, #42574, #42575, #42576 (same issue class in other tool-call parsers).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (N/A)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -29,7 +29,36 @@
 _PARAM_WITH_NAME_REGEX = re.compile(
     r"<param\s+name=[\'\"]([^\'\"]+)[\'\"]>([\s\S]*?)</param>", re.DOTALL
 )
-_PARAM_MISSING_NAME_REGEX = re.compile(r"<param(?![^>]*\bname=)[^>]*>", re.DOTALL)
+_NAME_ATTR_REGEX = re.compile(r"\bname=")
+
+
+def _has_param_missing_name(block: str) -> bool:
+    # Linear equivalent of `<param(?![^>]*\bname=)[^>]*>`.search(); that regex
+    # rescans to the next ">" from every "<param", quadratic without one.
+    pos = 0
+    while (start := block.find("<param", pos)) != -1:
+        tag_end = block.find(">", start)
+        if tag_end == -1:
+            return False
+        # The last "<param" before this ">" has the fewest attrs to check.
+        last = block.rfind("<param", start, tag_end)
+        if _NAME_ATTR_REGEX.search(block, last + len("<param"), tag_end) is None:
+            return True
+        pos = tag_end + 1
+    return False
+
+
+def _iter_delimited(text: str, start_token: str, end_token: str):
+    # Linear scan for `start.*?end` spans; a regex finditer rescans to the end
+    # from every start token when the end token never arrives.
+    start = text.find(start_token)
+    while start != -1:
+        end = text.find(end_token, start + len(start_token))
+        if end == -1:
+            return
+        end += len(end_token)
+        yield start, end
+        start = text.find(start_token, end)

+def test_unclosed_tags_parse_in_linear_time():
+    """Unclosed <function> / <param> tags must not stall the parser (it runs
+    on the event loop); a complete call before them still parses."""
+    detector = MiniCPM5Detector()
+    tools = make_tools_weather()
+    complete = (
+        '<function name="get_weather"><param name="city">Paris</param></function>'
+    )
+    unclosed_params = (
+        '<function name="get_weather">' + '<param name="city">' * 6000 + "</function>"
+    )
+
+    start = time.perf_counter()
+    result = detector.detect_and_parse(complete + "<function " * 10000, tools)
+    detector.detect_and_parse(unclosed_params, tools)
+    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
+
